plan: Drive: from Kuldo, about 145 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.83187, -128.14771, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk: 6.5 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 205 m, about 151 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 110 m E of the spot at 882 m (56.83988, -128.25167). Water: Currier Creek 30 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-17, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-16, closures 2026-10-16.
R6M-duck-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-17: about 912 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.09 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
